clue.text: Lowering fish to boat's bottom

indicators.note: to means the fish is attached on to the boat
in a down entry, the fish fixed to the bottom of the boat comes after it

parts.note: a scow is a flat-bottomed boat
the ling is a long sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A fisherman lowers his catch down to the bottom of a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lowering' looks like a verb of letting down, but here it is the adjective for a dark, threatening look.
explanation.definitionFit: A lowering expression is a sullen, frowning one, just like a scowling face.

clue.text: Motorists following as escorts creating disturbance

indicators.note: escorts means the word as accompanies the motorists, walking behind them in the line

parts.note: F is the standard abbreviation for following, as in page references
the RAC, Royal Automobile Club, is a British motoring organisation

explanation.surface: A convoy of drivers with an escort causes a commotion on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: The RAC is the Royal Automobile Club, a British breakdown and motoring association.
explanation.definitionFit: A fracas is a noisy quarrel or brawl, a public disturbance.

clue.text: Oil producer usual type deceptively adding in carbon

indicators.note: adding in means an extra letter is placed inside the jumbled letters
deceptively suggests the letters of usual type are disguised by being rearranged

parts.note: C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: A sly look at how an ordinary-looking oil source sneaks carbon into its product.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deceptively' turns USUAL TYPE into EUALYPTUS, and 'adding in' puts C (carbon) among those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The eucalyptus tree yields eucalyptus oil, distilled from its leaves, so it is a producer of oil.

clue.text: No sage as far as rustic one is concerned?

definitions.text: as far as rustic one is concerned
definitions.meaning: second meaning: '..., where 'un is the rural pronunciation of one and -wise means regarding, as in moneywise

explanation.walkthrough: The suffix -wise means 'with respect to', and 'un is a dialect spelling of 'one', so 'un-wise reads as 'as far as one is concerned'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is no sage lacks wisdom and judgement, so is foolish or imprudent.

clue.text: Come together! See lambs frolicking!

indicators.note: frolicking lambs leap about, so the letters of see lambs jump into a new order

explanation.surface: An excited call to gather round and watch lambs playing in a field.
explanation.definitionFit: To assemble is to gather or meet in one place as a group.

clue.text: Mark course in vessel circling lake

indicators.note: circling means the vessel goes round the lake's letter

parts.note: a pot is a vessel for cooking or holding liquid
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A sailor charts a route while the boat goes round a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: To plot a course is to mark it out on a chart or map.

clue.text: Figure of 11 or sign of Cross?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the ..., a foliate pagan figure revered in modern witchcraft
second meaning: the green walking man on a pedestrian crossing signal, taught in the Green Cross Code

explanation.walkthrough: 11 refers to the answer at 11-across, a pagan religion. The Green Cross Code is the British road-safety routine for crossing streets, whose signal shows a green man.
explanation.definitionFit: The Green Man is a leafy face in pagan folklore and also the walk symbol lit at pedestrian crossings.

clue.text: Bones in the ancient Cilician capital

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the ..., the group of small bones of the ankle
second meaning: ..., chief city of Cilicia in Asia Minor, birthplace of St Paul

explanation.walkthrough: Cilicia was a region on the south coast of what is now Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: The ankle's set of seven bones shares its name with the ancient city in southern Anatolia.

clue.text: Sister in Swiss laboratory turning thus sees the 28

indicators.note: in means the sister is placed inside the laboratory's name

parts.note: CERN is the particle physics laboratory near Geneva
a nun is a religious sister

indicators.note: turning means the word for thus is read backwards

parts.note: so means thus, therefore

explanation.surface: A nun touring a Swiss physics lab is surprised by what she finds there.
explanation.walkthrough: '28' refers to the answer at 28-across, the horned god; CERN famously has a statue of the dancing Shiva, which adds to the joke.
explanation.definitionFit: Cernunnos is the Celtic antlered deity, the best-known horned god of pagan tradition.

clue.text: Spanish poet's killer chasing Liberal

indicators.note: chasing means the killer comes after the Liberal, as a pursuer behind

parts.note: an orca is a killer whale

explanation.surface: A sinister picture of the murderer of a Spanish poet hunting down a political Liberal.
explanation.walkthrough: Lorca was in fact murdered by Nationalist forces in 1936, which gives the surface its dark edge.
explanation.definitionFit: Federico Garcia Lorca was a celebrated twentieth-century poet and dramatist from Andalusia.

clue.text: Fields about to involve one in magical practice?

indicators.note: to involve means one is taken into the comedian's initials

parts.note: W.C. Fields was the American comic actor, giving his initials
I is the Roman numeral for one
CA, circa, means about, approximately

explanation.surface: Fields, perhaps farmland, are about to be drawn into some kind of witchcraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fields' looks like farmland but is the comedian W. C. Fields.
explanation.definitionFit: Wicca is a modern pagan religion built around witchcraft, so it is a magical practice; the question mark admits it is a religion as well.

clue.text: Incompetence where ISS orbits planet for all to see disappearing

indicators.note: orbits means the space station's letters travel round the outside of the planet
disappearing means the letter for universal film viewing is lost

parts.note: Neptune is the eighth planet from the Sun
U is the British film certificate for universal, suitable for all audiences

explanation.surface: Mocking a space station that circles a planet and then visibly vanishes from sight.
explanation.walkthrough: ISS is the International Space Station, used as written. U is the British film rating meaning anyone may watch; taking it from NEPTUNE leaves NEPTNE.
explanation.definitionFit: Ineptness is a lack of skill or ability, the same thing as incompetence.

clue.text: Silent Y replaced with it

indicators.note: replaced means the letters of silent y are put back in a different order

explanation.surface: A spelling note: a silent letter Y has been swapped for the word it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being with it means fashionable and up to date, which is being in style.

clue.text: Constant and sacred syllable used among workers in suits

indicators.note: used among means these letters are placed in the middle of the workers

parts.note: bees are the classic crossword workers, from worker bees
C is the symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light
om is the sacred syllable chanted in Hindu and Buddhist meditation

explanation.surface: Office workers in business suits chant a meditation syllable to keep calm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suits' looks like part of 'workers in suits', office staff, but it is the verb that defines the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A colour that becomes you flatters you, which is what it means to say it suits you.

clue.text: Traditional performer hindered response to an audience?

indicators.note: to an audience means the phrase is judged by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: a hindered response is a clogged answer, one that is blocked

explanation.surface: A performer gives a stumbling, blocked reply to the questions from an audience.
explanation.walkthrough: Said quickly, 'clogged answer' runs together into the sound of the folk performer; clog dancing is a traditional step dance in wooden shoes from northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: A clog dancer performs a traditional folk dance in wooden-soled shoes, beating out rhythms.

clue.text: Good bread consecrated for wraith

parts.note: the host is the consecrated bread of the Eucharist

explanation.surface: Good communion bread is blessed to ward off a spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: A wraith is a spectre or apparition, especially of a dead person.

clue.text: Decorate religious work with gold title to start

indicators.note: to start means gold and title come first, ahead of the religious work

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
a name is a title
NT, the New Testament, is a religious work

explanation.surface: Instructions to embellish a sacred text with gilded lettering for its title.
explanation.definitionFit: To ornament something is to adorn or embellish it, so it is to decorate.

clue.text: Beastly prong to have first point missing in moor?

indicators.note: missing means the compass letter is taken out of the prong

parts.note: a tine is a prong of an antler, an animal's horn
N, north, is the first point of the compass

explanation.surface: An antlered beast on the moorland has lost the tip of its prong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moor' looks like heathland, but it is the verb for securing a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To moor a boat is to tie it up to a post or quay.

clue.text: Vampire saga with one large drunk outside

indicators.note: outside means the drunk word goes round the other letters

parts.note: tight is slang for drunk
I is the Roman numeral for one
L is the clothing abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A vampire story in which a big drunk figure is shut out of doors.
explanation.definitionFit: Twilight is Stephenie Meyer's series of vampire romance novels, later filmed.

clue.text: Wife a certain duke's snatched becomes possessed

indicators.note: snatched means the wife is grabbed and held inside

parts.note: one means a certain, as in 'one Mr Smith'
D is the abbreviation for duke

explanation.surface: A noble scandal: a duke runs off with a wife, who becomes his property.
explanation.definitionFit: Owned and possessed both mean held as one's property.

clue.text: Underworld deity watches over balloons

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld
tends means looks after, watches over

explanation.surface: A god of the dead keeps watch over a set of balloons.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that distends swells out or inflates, as balloons do when blown up.

clue.text: Big Brother welcomes international runner

indicators.note: welcomes means the brother takes the big letters inside

parts.note: a monk is a religious brother
OS, outsize, is the clothing abbreviation for big

explanation.surface: The reality show Big Brother brings in a sprinter from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Big Brother' reads as the TV show or Orwell's dictator, but the two words must be split; OS (outsize) is a British clothing size mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A monoski is a single broad ski, and skis are runners that glide over snow.

clue.text: Figure of 11's hot-dogs Mrs Dee prepared

indicators.note: prepared means the letters are made ready in a new form, as food is cooked

explanation.surface: A woman named Mrs Dee cooks hot dogs for a pagan gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 11 is the answer at 11-across, a pagan faith that honours a female deity alongside the horned god.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mother Goddess is the female deity of fertility revered in many pagan religions.

clue.text: See 21
Note from musical instrument under G&S

indicators.note: under means, in a down entry, the instrument sits below the initials

parts.note: Gilbert and Sullivan, the operetta partnership, give their initials
a harp is a stringed musical instrument

explanation.surface: A note from an orchestral instrument in a Gilbert and Sullivan operetta.
explanation.definitionFit: G sharp is a musical note, a semitone above G.

clue.text: Years after corruption in genre, it's E for Einstein?

indicators.note: after means the years letter follows the rearranged letters
corruption in the word genre means its letters are corrupted into a new order

explanation.surface: Musing on a corrupted genre and what E stands for in Einstein's famous equation.
explanation.walkthrough: In Einstein's E = mc squared, E stands for energy; the question mark marks this as a definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: In the mass-energy equation the symbol E denotes the quantity of work available, so energy.

clue.text: As hoyden my boot's in tatters: his likewise?

indicators.note: in tatters means the letters are torn up and scattered
likewise says the word his is torn up in the same way

parts.note: my boot, with 's read as 'is'

explanation.surface: A rough-and-tumble girl complains her boot is ragged, and his too.
explanation.walkthrough: A hoyden is an old word for a boisterous, unladylike girl.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoyden is a high-spirited girl who behaves like a boy, so acting as one is being tomboyish.

clue.text: Curse as horse brought to grass

indicators.note: brought to means the horse letter is attached to the end of the grass

parts.note: oat is a cereal grass
H is slang shorthand for heroin, which is also called horse

explanation.surface: Someone swears as a horse is led out to graze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horse' looks like the animal led to graze, but it is slang for heroin, whose shorthand is H.
explanation.definitionFit: An oath is a profane exclamation, so a curse or swear word.

clue.text: Inheritance finally claimed by particular relative

indicators.note: claimed by means the letter is taken inside the word for particular

parts.note: nice means particular, fussy, precise

indicators.note: finally means only the closing letter of inheritance is used

explanation.surface: A family member finally lays claim to an inheritance.
explanation.definitionFit: A niece, a sibling's daughter, is a family relation.

clue.text: Grave shouldn't hold American or second European artist

indicators.note: shouldn't hold means the grave word must not keep these letters, so they are dropped

parts.note: earnest means grave, serious
E is the abbreviation for European; it is the second E of the grave word that goes

explanation.surface: A graveyard rule: an American, or a second European artist, must not be buried here.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the A and the second E from EARNEST.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Ernst was a German painter and a leading Surrealist and Dada artist.

clue.text: Working on herd, Lassie perhaps recalled figure of 11

indicators.note: working means the letters of on herd are worked into a new shape
recalled means the word is called back, read backwards

parts.note: Lassie, the film collie, is an example of a dog

explanation.surface: A sheepdog is called back from working the herd, recalling a famous collie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lassie' is the famous collie of film and TV; the 'perhaps' marks a dog as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: The Horned God is the male deity of modern pagan witchcraft, partner of the Mother Goddess.
